title: Intro Framing #1
text: Welcome. Take a moment to transition from whatever was filling your day into this quiet space you've set aside.

title: Intro Framing #2
text: As you begin, remember there is nowhere else you need to be right now and nothing else you need to accomplish.

title: Intro Framing #3
text: Allowing yourself to step off the wheel of doing, and stepping gently into the space of simply being.

title: Intro Framing #4
text: Setting a gentle intention to remain present, open, and curious for the duration of this practice.

title: Intro Framing #5
text: Giving yourself full permission to drop the demands of your schedule and rest into stillness.

title: Intro Framing #6
text: Arriving right here, right now, as you let go of what came before and whatever comes next.

title: Intro Framing #7
text: Taking a moment to acknowledge yourself for carving out this time for balance and presence.

title: Intro Framing #8
text: Let your awareness settle gently into this room, this body, and this moment.

title: Intro Framing #9
text: Stepping out of the stream of daily activity and inviting a sense of peaceful focus.

title: Intro Framing #10
text: As we begin, let go of any expectations for how this meditation should feel.

title: Posture Setup #1
text: Finding a comfortable posture, whether sitting or lying down, allowing your spine to be naturally upright yet relaxed.

title: Posture Setup #2
text: Let your shoulders drop away from your ears, releasing any holding in your jaw, neck, and chest.

title: Posture Setup #3
text: Resting your hands comfortably on your lap or by your side, allowing your body to feel grounded and fully supported.

title: Posture Setup #4
text: If you are seated, feel your feet flat on the ground, establishing a stable and steady foundation.

title: Posture Setup #5
text: Gently softening the muscle around your eyes, unclenching the jaw, and letting your belly relax.

title: Posture Setup #6
text: Lengthening lightly through the crown of your head while letting your lower body rest heavily into your seat.

title: Posture Setup #7
text: Allowing your posture to embody a quality of quiet dignity—alert, yet completely at ease.

title: Posture Setup #8
text: Checking in with your body, making any minor adjustments so you can sit with minimal strain.

title: Posture Setup #9
text: Softening the face, loosening the neck, and letting the arms hang freely.

title: Posture Setup #10
text: Feeling the physical points of contact between your body and the surface beneath you.

title: Primary Focus #1
text: Bringing your attention now to the physical sensation of breathing, noticing the rise and fall of the chest or abdomen.

title: Primary Focus #2
text: Following the full trajectory of one in-breath, and the complete flow of one out-breath.

title: Primary Focus #3
text: Noticing where you feel the breath most distinctly—perhaps at the nostrils, the back of the throat, or the belly.

title: Primary Focus #4
text: There is no need to alter or control your breathing. Simply let the body breathe itself.

title: Primary Focus #5
text: Riding the natural wave of the breath, resting your awareness in each movement.

title: Primary Focus #6
text: Anchor your mind to the quiet sensation of air passing in and out of the body.

title: Primary Focus #7
text: Noticing the subtle pause at the top of the inhalation, and the brief stillness at the end of the exhalation.

title: Primary Focus #8
text: Allowing the breath to be your home base—a simple, steady anchor in the present moment.

title: Primary Focus #9
text: Feeling the subtle expansion as you inhale, and the gentle release as you exhale.

title: Primary Focus #10
text: Whenever you need a grounding point, return your attention to the rhythm of the breath.

title: Attitudinal #1
text: Practicing an attitude of non-striving. You aren't trying to fix anything or achieve a special state.

title: Attitudinal #2
text: Meeting whatever arises with patience, allowing things to be exactly as they already are.

title: Attitudinal #3
text: Bringing a sense of soft curiosity to your experience, free from judgment or criticism.

title: Attitudinal #4
text: If you notice tension or discomfort, see if you can soften around it rather than resisting it.

title: Attitudinal #5
text: Approaching yourself with kindness and openness, welcoming whatever is here.

title: Attitudinal #6
text: Observing your experience like weather passing through the open sky—constant, shifting, and temporary.

title: Attitudinal #7
text: Resting in beginner's mind, witnessing this breath as if it were the very first time.

title: Attitudinal #8
text: Releasing the need to control. Simply letting experience unfold moment by moment.

title: Attitudinal #9
text: Allowing yourself to be an compassionate observer of your own mind and body.

title: Attitudinal #10
text: There is no right or wrong way to feel right now. Simply stay open to what is.

title: Mind Wandering #1
text: If you notice your mind has drifted into thoughts or plans, simply notice where it went without judgment.

title: Mind Wandering #2
text: Mind wandering is completely natural. The moment you notice it, you are already back.

title: Mind Wandering #3
text: Gently acknowledge whatever pulled your attention away, and guide your focus smoothly back to the breath.

title: Mind Wandering #4
text: Thoughts will arise like bubbles in water. Notice them, let them pop, and return to the anchor.

title: Mind Wandering #5
text: No need to be frustrated when the mind strays. Each awakening is an opportunity to practice gentle return.

title: Mind Wandering #6
text: Whenever the story of the mind takes over, unhook kindly and return to the sensation of this breath.

title: Mind Wandering #7
text: Quietly label the distraction as 'thinking' or 'planning', and let it drift away.

title: Mind Wandering #8
text: Softly release the thought, let your shoulders drop, and re-center on the physical anchor.

title: Mind Wandering #9
text: Bringing the mind back with the same firmness and patience you would offer a young child.

title: Mind Wandering #10
text: Noticing where the mind was... and softly bringing awareness back to right here.

title: Sustained Silence #1
text: Resting now in quiet awareness for the next few moments.

title: Sustained Silence #2
text: Allowing yourself to settle into the stillness.

title: Sustained Silence #3
text: Sinking deeper into open, quiet presence.

title: Sustained Silence #4
text: Maintaining your anchor as we sit together in quiet.

title: Sustained Silence #5
text: Letting the voice fade away, remaining with the breath.

title: Sustained Silence #6
text: Exploring the quiet space between thoughts.

title: Sustained Silence #7
text: Resting gently in the silence.

title: Sustained Silence #8
text: Allowing the stillness to settle around you.

title: Sustained Silence #9
text: Simply breathing, in open stillness.

title: Sustained Silence #10
text: Holding a gentle awareness through this space of quiet.

title: Somatic Reentry #1
text: Gently expanding your awareness back into the whole physical body, feeling the breath moving through you.

title: Somatic Reentry #2
text: Noticing the contact of your body with your seat, feeling anchored and present.

title: Somatic Reentry #3
text: Inviting small movements into your fingers and toes as you slowly wake up the body.

title: Somatic Reentry #4
text: Taking a deeper in-breath, filling the chest, and letting out a long, relaxing sigh.

title: Somatic Reentry #5
text: Bringing awareness to the sounds in the room around you, reorienting to your space.

title: Somatic Reentry #6
text: Carrying this sense of quiet calm with you as you prepare to transition back to your day.

title: Somatic Reentry #7
text: Feeling the grounding support of the earth beneath you as your awareness expands.

title: Somatic Reentry #8
text: Allowing a moment of gratitude for taking this time for your health and well-being.

title: Somatic Reentry #9
text: Slowly deepening your breath, feeling refreshed, grounded, and clear.

title: Somatic Reentry #10
text: When you feel ready, gently open your eyes or un-focus your gaze, taking in the room around you.
